# Python format oracles of the CI tool setup (install-tools.sh, task_pip), one pin per line. The hash of this file is
# the key of the wheel cache.
# scipy is pinned with trimesh: the distro scipy (built for NumPy 1) is also on the image, and with the NumPy 2 that pip
# installs here it makes `import trimesh` fail with a binary-incompatibility error, so pip's own scipy has to shadow it.

duckdb==1.5.6
# DuckDB imports pytz when it hands a TIMESTAMPTZ value to Python (bench/reference-server.py, data.check) and declares no dependency on it.
